body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would force the target to move or make it Prone. Response (unopposed): Reduce forced movement by 2 units and prevent that Prone effect.

surges.html: Suppress an ordinary Poison penalty on the target until the start of your next turn.
Reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.
